summary.intent: Fix PR #638 (trail #487): the fixed MultiSelect page size of 15 in `callisto add` overflows short terminals, so inquire 0.9.4 redraws against the previous frame and the highlight and checkboxes land on the wrong rows. Cap the page size to the terminal height, apply the same to other paged prompts in add/init, add a pty test, run the full gate, and commit locally (signed) without pushing.
summary.outcome: Added `tty::page_size`, which caps the page to terminal rows minus 2 with a minimum of 3 and falls back to the wanted size when the size is unknown. Applied it to the add MultiSelect and the init Select, and added a 10-row pty test with 20 packages that fails without the fix and passes with it. The gate commands (fmt, pre-push, lint, doc-check, test) were run and a signed commit was attempted, but the transcript shows no exit codes, sha, or signature status, so results are not confirmed. The checklist at review-checklist.md was not visibly run, and no report to the lead was produced.

repo: crossterm was not a direct dependency of callisto-cli (only via inquire's backend), so using `crossterm::terminal::size` required adding `crossterm = { version = "0.29", default-features = false }` to crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml and updating Cargo.lock.
Terminal helpers live in crates/callisto-cli/src/tty.rs; the page-size cap was placed there as `page_size`/`fit_page` with LIST_CHROME=2 and MIN_PAGE=3 constants.
The init command's TerminalPrompter used an unpaged `Select::new(...).raw_prompt()`, so it needed the same page cap as a sibling call site (new PAGE=7 const).
The pty test harness in crates/callisto-cli/tests/add_interactive_pty_tests.rs hard-coded ws_row 30; it was extended with a `rows` parameter on `launch` and a `start_sized` helper.
No terminal-emulator crate (vt100, vte, etc.) is available, so the pty test asserts on the raw output stream and the resulting changeset file instead of a rendered screen.

code.finding: Added `page_size(wanted)` and `fit_page(wanted, terminal_rows)`; result is `wanted.min(rows - 2).max(3)`, or `wanted` if the terminal size is unknown. `fit_page` is split out so it can be unit tested without a tty.
The init Select now passes `.with_page_size(tty::page_size(PAGE))`, with a new `PAGE = 7` constant above `TerminalPrompter`.

workflow: Verify a regression test is red without the fix by temporarily reverting the one-line change, then restore it, before running the full gate.
On macOS, BSD `sed -i` requires an empty suffix argument (`sed -i ''`); GNU-style `sed -i` fails.
The repo's `rtk` wrapper (`rtk just ...`, `rtk grep`) worked where plain `just` and `grep` calls in the same pipelines gave no usable output.
The pty test first ran as an exploratory test that panics and prints the raw stream, which showed what to assert before the real assertions were written.
Run the gate steps one at a time and report each exit code (`echo name=$?`) instead of relying on a single chained pass/fail.

friction: The first `sed -i` attempt failed on macOS BSD sed, so the revert-and-check step had to be redone with `-i ''`.
The first gate run through plain `just` was repeated through `rtk just`, which suggests the first attempt gave no usable result.
The first test assertion waited on `[ ] p10` and had to be loosened to `[ ]` to match the raw stream.
The test's initial design (ticking p10) was changed to unticking, since the items are preselected.
